events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW pop-up at Saint Coffee featuring a preview of White House Black Market's fall collection alongside complimentary refreshments.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee and black-and-white cookies are advertised. NYC Plugged also reports a signature WHBM shirt to take home, but promotional quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current listings describe the activation as open to the public. Complimentary items are promotional and may be quantity-limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 7th Avenue. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up with a hair and makeup refresh station, photo booth, legwear shopping and customization experiences.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, a photo booth and skincare sampling are advertised. Hand embroidery is free with purchase of eligible 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Multiple current listings describe the pop-up as open to the public. Embroidery is purchase-linked; other promotional services and samples may be capacity- or supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 12–13, from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or host-approval requirement is published in the verified sources.

occurrences.details: Open to the public; complimentary coffee and cookies advertised.
